Definition: Uri, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Uri = "fiery"; 1) a prince of Judah, a son of Hur who was used by God to prepare the tabernacle; 2) an officer (or the father of an officer) of Solomon in Gilead; 3) a porter or gatekeeper in time of Ezra who took a foreign woman as wife
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
